tasks.title: Status settings resolve into a validated snapshot with field origins
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, settings/runtime-settings/theme-config files and corresponding Checks; Decisions 2, 7, 9-10; R1 status shapes/report trimming; Counterexamples (precedence, reset, theme). Pin merged contract 2.4.0 and use its theme constants. Record whether env fields were explicitly set, including false equal to a default and trimmed-empty unset. Resolve env > file > database > default per token/field into one snapshot with canonical-JSON SHA-256 first-16-hex fingerprint, CSS, CSP inputs, logo, component order, four switches and locked report. Validate local settings/theme files and the mutual-theme conflict; preserve env-only local logo support. Add service-token/file and settings-poll env validation without enabling live I/O until T2. Test pure resolution/report trimming locally with injected inputs; T2 owns polling/application.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Literal per-field precedence/reset matrix covers name, https logo without userinfo, color per mode, font, radius, componentOrder and all 4 flags in both directions. Explicit PULSE_STATUS_SHOW_CHECKS=false overrides database true and is locked; empty env is unset. File accent #112233 overrides database #445566 while database bg #ffffff remains. Removing file key restores DB, clearing DB restores defaults; absent settings retain today's defaults. Both theme sources conflict with startup exit 2; token+token-file and unreadable/empty file exit 2 without token text; empty token-file env is unset. Fingerprint is 16 hex, stable for identical canonical input and changes with effective settings. A 500-entry escaped componentOrder report is <=524288 bytes after lock values are omitted in R1 order.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Live status changes update privacy, assets and open pages without stale answers
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, remaining Files, live Behavior, all Checks and Completion evidence; Decisions 5-10; R1 report bounds; Counterexamples (order, visibility, in-flight and stale reports); Security impact; Performance impact (status); Acceptance evidence 2-3, 5 and 7. Poll every 15000 ms with 5000-ms timeout, wire validation, 1048576-byte limit and If-None-Match; reread local files even on 304 and with no token, retain last good on invalid data/file/outage and report attempts plus 60000-ms heartbeat only when token set. Startup with token gates public readiness until 200/304/404; 404 empties DB and logs once. Atomically apply T1 snapshots to server, CSS/ETag, CSP, logo, name, order, all flags and report origins. Keep fingerprint cache invalidation and in-flight filtering together. Withhold latency/SLO fields and rendering, add latencyMs:0 to the poller's validation copy only, preserve browser-safe imports. Serve no-store /page-settings.json, page data-settings and one reload on fingerprint change; shut down polling cleanly. Finish docs including full/dev showChecks lock.
